description: Generate BUILD HANDOFFs for cycle tasks that don't have one yet. Run after `plan` (with skip_handoffs=true) or to regenerate stale handoffs. Uses bounded prepare/apply batches so large cycles resume safely; first call prepares one hosted task or a local file-backed batch, second call persists results.

cycle_number.description: The cycle number returned from prepare phase (mode "apply" only).

force.description: Regenerate handoffs for tasks that ALREADY have one, overwriting the stored handoff (default false = only fill in missing handoffs). Use to propagate a changed Active Decision or dependency into an in-flight task. Pass on the prepare call (it is remembered through apply); combine with task_ids to target specific tasks.

llm_response.description: Your raw output from executing the handoff prompt (mode "apply" only). Must include both Part 1 (markdown) and Part 2 (structured JSON after <!-- PAPI_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT -->, inside a ```json fence). Each cycleHandoffs entry needs EITHER a buildHandoff string in the BUILD HANDOFF markdown template (section headers on their own lines: SCOPE (DO THIS) / SCOPE BOUNDARY (DO NOT DO THIS) / ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA / EFFORT) OR structured fields alongside taskId: {scope: string[], scopeBoundary: string[], acceptanceCriteria: Array<string | {text: string, check?: {kind:"command",run:string} | {kind:"http",url:string,expect:"2xx"} | {kind:"grep",file:string,pattern:string,expect:"present"|"absent"}}>, effort: "XS|S|M|L|XL"}. A criterion is a plain string unless it carries a typed check the BUILDER'S HOST runs and reports back (task-3223) — PAPI never executes one. Mutually exclusive with llm_response_file.

llm_response_file.description: Absolute path to a file containing the handoff output (mode "apply" only). LOCAL stdio servers only — on the hosted connection the server cannot read files on your machine; pass llm_response inline instead. Use instead of llm_response when the output exceeds tool parameter size limits. Mutually exclusive with llm_response.

mode.description: "prepare" returns the handoff prompt for you to execute. "apply" accepts your generated output and persists handoffs. Defaults to "prepare" when omitted.

task_ids.description: Specific task IDs to generate handoffs for. If omitted, generates for all cycle tasks missing handoffs.

name: handoff_generate
